title: Axis deer damage and control programs
summary: At the April 2026 meeting, a ranching group leader said Maui ranchers have cut herds by over 50 percent because deer compete for grass, and a testifier asked for county support for farmers and ranchers. In 2025, a researcher said the axis deer herd grows over 20% a year and removing 30% a year would begin shrinking it. A deer and feral animal grant was set at $2.5 million, with up to $100,000 per grantee.
